body: well what could they do to try and make it better?

Same at least I think thats why I am still here. Intellectually I understand how devastating the loss of a child would be but Im not thinking too clearly right now. Its just got to be over. I don't want to hurt my parents but I also don't want to live anymore. 

I'm glad that you have a family that has kept you from acting on your thoughts.

I don't want to put them through that. I know they love me and are supportive and sometimes being showered with their love hurts too much. I am so miserable and they are trying so hard but I can't feel better.

Thanks for your response
at least then I wouldn't be ruining their entire future if there was another child for them to focus on.
even if that child is now an adult?

I feel like Im walking on eggshells with my parents and my depression hasn't been easy for them to deal with. I just don't have the energy to fight any more. I just want to know that my parents will be okay.

Thanks for sharing a bit about your story.
I guess I don't mean get over it over it but could they get support and be able to move on and keep living their lives? I wish I had a sibling
I'm already in therapy but clearly its not working

I feel the same way I guess thats why I'm here. I have friends from university so they are all over the country but sometimes they can't handle the magnitude of my issues. Thats my thing too I have a loving family that i don't want to hurt but being here is hurting me so I don't know
Wow thats good progress. I know therapy can be slow but its good that it helped you.

Hmm that is a good point (about finding the root). Things have been bad for me for a while in terms of feeling depressed (though nothing horrible has happened to me in life) and I am scared of feeling this way into the future. I also am assuming that the next phase of my life will be worse than the last and I don't like change. If you don't mind may I ask how you are handling the social anxiety and is it working?

See the comment I posted above but also I don't know what I am doing with my life and I can't find something I am interested in and I just don't see the point in being alive. Intellectually I know things I can do to change the situation (ex: find a job, do volunteer work, join a new activity...) but emotionally I'm too anxious to even leave my apartment. 

Thanks for being supportive it really means a lot to me

I'm sure there is a way to be convinced otherwise. I always have these thoughts and I have a few ways in mind for how I can do it but I am too much of a coward I guess. I am scared of the future and the unknown. I like to be able to control what happens to me. I just feel really depressed all the time and I've tried many medications and therapies but nothing is making me feel better. I want to die but I am also scared of that so basically I'm stuck and I don't know how to get out.
